method_note: block bootstrap (streak-preserving) — the honest drawdown estimate
honesty_note: Resampled from REPLAY trades (survivorship-biased, INDICATIVE only) unless source=live. No trades are invented; only recorded R-multiples are reshuffled.
concurrency_caveat: %-drawdown assumes NON-overlapping positions, but policy allows 6 concurrent — real %-equity drawdown can be up to ~6x worse if positions are correlated and lose together.

risk_of_ruin.note: P(equity drawdown >= ruin level) across resampled orderings; tests sequence-of-returns risk. REPLAY-based unless source=live.
